title: Unpacking Interpretability: Human-Centered Criteria for Optimal Combinatorial Solutions
abstract: arXiv:2603.08856v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Algorithmic support systems can return solutions that are optimal but hard to interpret for humans. A given problem can have multiple, equally optimal solutions that differ substantially in how interpretable they are. Yet there is no precise account of what makes one solution more interpretable than another. To identify structural properties associated with interpretability, we studied a packing paradigm based on the multiple subset sum problem (MSSP), in which participants judged which of two equally optimal solutions for packing items into bins was easier to understand. We found that preferences reliably tracked three properties of solution structure: alignment with a greedy heuristic, simple within-bin composition, and how ordered the visual representation was. translated_title: 解读可解释性：面向最优组合解的以人为中心的评判标准
translated_abstract: 算法支持系统所返回的解虽然是最优的，但可能对人类而言难以理解。同一个问题可能存在多个同等最优、但在可解释性上差异显著的解。然而，目前尚无精确的理论来解释究竟是什么使一个解比另一个解更易于理解。为了识别与可解释性相关的结构性质，我们研究了基于多子集求和问题（MSSP）的装箱实验范式，让参与者判断将物品装入箱子的两个同等最优解中哪一个更容易理解。我们发现，参与者的偏好可靠地追踪了解结构的三个性质：与贪心启发式算法的一致性、箱内物品组成的简单性，以及视觉表示的有序程度。其中，有序的视觉表示和与贪心启发式的一致性表现出最强的关联，组成简单性也显示出一致的相关性。
tldr: 该研究通过人类实验发现，同等最优的组合解中，人们更容易理解那些与贪心启发式算法一致、箱内组成简单、且视觉表示有序的解，其中有序表示和贪心一致性对可解释性的影响最强。
en_tdlr: This study identifies three structural properties—alignment with a greedy heuristic, simple within-bin composition, and ordered visual representation—that reliably predict which of equally optimal combinatorial solutions humans find more interpretable, with ordered representations and greedy alignment showing the strongest effects.
